convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators and standard trading functions. Simple pivot-based entry/exit with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No complex money management or multi-timeframe logic.

other_exits: Close long when price reaches PP or R1
Close short when price reaches PP or S1

custom_logic_notes: Classic pivot point system. Pivot levels recalculated daily from previous D1 bar OHLC. Entry triggers when price breaks below S1 (long) or above R1 (short). SL placed at next support/resistance level. TP at pivot or opposite level. Digit adjustment applied: SL/TP multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 for proper pip conversion on 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Pivot levels are trivially computed from previous daily bar OHLC. No indicator handles needed. Must track daily bar boundary to recalculate pivots. Digit adjustment logic (_Digits==5 multiply by 10) must be replicated for SL/TP. Position check before entry is straightforward. New bar detection requires tracking bar time. All logic is self-contained with no external dependencies.
